'''Kole Hendry''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a conflict fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He sold various [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]] near the [[Thul Palace]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].
